# Gene Roth Advisory, LLC

> AI-assisted regulatory compliance advisory for airports, DBEs/ACDBEs, consultants, and concession and construction primes — led by a former FAA compliance director.

## What we do

- Advisory & Consulting — fractional chief of staff, business development, DBE/ACDBE program advisory, Title VI and ADA / Section 504 compliance programs, and regulatory program design.
- AI-Powered Compliance Tools — compliance audit agents, a RAG-based DBE/ACDBE narrative builder, certification deadline and IFR recertification tracking, and regulatory change detection.
- Data & Analytics — airport operational performance, airline passenger experience, environmental compliance, and certification-rate analytics built on federal datasets (7M+ BTS flight records).
- AI & Technology Services — custom compliance SaaS, agentic AI workflow design, RAG system architecture, and LLM integration.

## Key expertise

- DBE certification
- ACDBE certification
- 49 CFR Part 26
- 49 CFR Part 23
- Title VI compliance
- ADA / Section 504 accessibility
- FAA airport compliance
- AI compliance tools
- RAG systems
